title: The text describes the story of Frankie Barrett, a young traveller from Galway who became a champion boxer. Frankie's journey to success was marked by challenges and setbacks, including a near-death experience in 1996. Despite these obstacles, Frankie continued to pursue his passion for boxing and eventually became a hero in his community. The text also highlights the importance of perseverance and the value of following one's dreams.
